title: Fraud score
hint: Combined from where they sign in (ipinfo.io), their ID check, proofs of address, payouts, background check and account. Higher is riskier. It shows what to look at; it doesn't decide anything.

notScored.address: No proof of address read yet

factors.ip_relay: A privacy relay (iCloud Private Relay or Cloudflare WARP)
factors.ip_hosting: A data center or cloud server, not a home or phone network
factors.ip_other_state: In a different state from their home city
factors.ip_shared: {count, plural, one {Also used by # other account} other {Also used by # other accounts}}
factors.id_not_genuine: The license doesn't look genuine (its barcode or number)
factors.id_barcode_doubtful: The barcode couldn't be fully confirmed
factors.id_front_differs: The front doesn't match the barcode
factors.id_face_mismatch: The selfie doesn't match the ID photo
factors.id_not_live: The selfie may not be of a live person
factors.id_photo_tampered: Signs the photos were edited, copied or taken of a screen
factors.id_duplicate: The same ID is on another account
factors.id_name_differs: The name differs from the account's
factors.id_under_18: Under 18 by the ID's birth date
factors.id_unreadable: The ID couldn't be read clearly
factors.id_rejected_before: {count, plural, one {# earlier try turned down} other {# earlier tries turned down}}
factors.address_name_differs: The name on it differs from the account's
factors.address_differs: The address on it differs from the one entered
factors.address_not_accepted: Not an accepted kind of document
factors.address_rejected_before: {count, plural, one {# earlier proof turned down} other {# earlier proofs turned down}}
factors.payout_requirements_due: Stripe needs more information from them
factors.background_adverse: Adverse action on the background check
factors.account_new: Account made in the last 2 days
factors.account_contact_hold: On hold after a "Not you?" link

ips.title: Sign-ins and IP addresses
ips.hint: Every address they used: sign-ins (kept a year), agreements they accepted and other actions, each looked up on ipinfo.io and scored. Places are approximate: a phone network or a VPN can place someone far from where they are.
ips.none: No addresses recorded. Sign-ins are kept a year; before 27 November 2026 an address was only kept while its sign-in lasted.

unavailableReasons.limit: ipinfo.io's free lookups are used up for now. Try again in a few minutes.
unavailableReasons.failed: ipinfo.io didn't answer. Try again in a minute.

ips.signIns: {count, plural, =0 {No sign-ins} one {# sign-in} other {# sign-ins}}
